verdict.rationale: Evidence shows only static documentation pages and code snippets (e.g. autogen-docs-23, autogen-docs-1) plus a separate AutoGen Studio GUI for building/testing agent teams (autogen-docs-7), but no interactive API reference (e.g. OpenAPI/Swagger explorer) or in-browser runnable examples.
